errors.evidence: The description identifies the line by number and visual style but omits what the line represents according to the legend (Städtische Regionen, Ein- und Zweifamilienhäuser). This omission is repeated for all six lines, making the detailed description of trends difficult to associate with the categories mentioned in the chart's purpose.
The marker for line 1 is an asterisk or star, not an 'x' marker.
The value for line 1 in 1984 is closer to 26% than 27%.
For line 4, the value does not rise to 24% around the year 2000. It actually dips to about 21.5% in 2000 before rising to a peak of 24% around 2002.
For line 4, the value is already at approximately 21% in 2013 and does not rise significantly during the 2015-2017 period; it remains relatively flat around that level.
Line 4 ends in 2020 at a value closer to 22%, not 21%.
Line 5 starts in 1984 clearly above the 10% mark, at approximately 11%.
Line 5 does not rise to 11% by 1985; it starts at around 11% in 1984 and remains at that level in 1985.
